status: proposed; run in each target host before submission

positive.prompt: Create a tiny tap-to-reveal post and publish it as a guest.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one post, return its confirmed public URL, private claim link and actual expiry. No sign-in demanded. Open and exercise the published post.

positive.prompt: Check the public state of the post we just published.
positive.expected_behavior: Read its ready/claimed/revision state without exposing or inventing edit rights.

positive.prompt: Change the reveal text in that guest post to Hello again and publish the update.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the existing post and upload capability, save a fresh request identifier, use its current revision and return a new revision of the same post.

positive.prompt: Connect my Differ account and upload this small post so I can preview it before publishing.
positive.expected_behavior: The human completes host OAuth. Confirm the account and upload a draft; report that it is not published yet and give the returned preview/publish URL. Connection alone must not claim earlier guest posts.

positive.prompt: Publish these finished local files as my connected Differ account immediately, without another preview.
positive.expected_behavior: In a host with file access and outbound HTTPS, hash each file and save one request with publish:true, obtain a pass for those exact files and details, upload unchanged, and return a confirmed live receipt. Report inability honestly on hosts without those capabilities.

negative.prompt: Make a local draft post for me to review; do not upload or publish anything.
negative.expected_behavior: Create a local or host draft without reserving, uploading or publishing any post.

negative.prompt: Overwrite this other creator's post using only its public URL.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that a public link gives no edit authority. Offer a separately authorized diff, without claiming ownership or attempting another person's mutation.

negative.prompt: The publisher returned success. Tell me anonymous live updates and cross-user permissions are verified.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the receipt confirms publication only. Run the required runtime/browser checks when available or explicitly report those behaviors unverified.
